name: rein
description: Spend limits for AI agents that pay with x402: every paywall is policy-checked before a cent moves.
long_description: Rein is the control plane for AI agent payments. Every x402 payment the agent attempts through rein_fetch is checked against your policy before anything is signed: per-call caps, budgets, allow and deny lists, human approval and a kill switch. Every decision is signed and receipted. Non-custodial: Rein governs the authority to spend, never the funds. Get a free testnet sandbox and the agent file this server needs with `npx @reinconsole/init`.

tools.name: rein_fetch
tools.description: HTTP fetch with x402 payments governed by Rein: a paywall is policy-checked before any money moves.

tools.name: rein_status
tools.description: The rules this agent is subject to and its standing against them: policies, spend-breaker counters, engine posture.

tools.name: rein_receipts
tools.description: This session's receipts for every payment decision, allowed or not, plus reconciliation against settlement.

tools.name: rein_escalations
tools.description: Payments policy escalated to a human; each expires into a denial if nobody signs an approval.

tools.name: rein_heartbeat
tools.description: Tell Rein this agent is still working, for dead-man monitoring when it is not buying anything.
